name: BrainlessITC Request Product Quote for WooCommerce
author: brainlessitc

sections.description:
BrainlessITC Request Product Quote for WooCommerce adds an “Add to quote” button to your products. Customers collect products in a quote list, fill in a short form and send you a request. You manage every request from a clean dashboard screen and reply by email in one click.

Perfect for B2B and wholesale stores, made-to-order products, bulk orders, products without a fixed price, or any store that wants to negotiate before selling.

Free features

  • “Add to quote” button on product pages and on shop / category pages (classic themes and WooCommerce blocks)
  • Simple and variable products (including “any” attributes)
  • Products without a price can be quoted
  • Quote list page with quantity update and remove (AJAX, works without JavaScript too)
  • Catalog mode: hide prices (with optional replacement text) and hide Add to cart — globally or per product
  • Add to cart is also blocked server side (classic, AJAX and Store API / blocks) for quote-only products
  • Request form with first name, last name, email, phone, company and message — enable/disable, require and relabel each field
  • Privacy policy checkbox
  • Spam protection: honeypot, submit-time check and per-IP rate limit
  • Quotes dashboard: list with status filters, search, bulk actions; detail screen with notes and status
  • Reply to the customer from the quote screen (email with the requested products)
  • Emails for the admin and the customer, fully customisable in WooCommerce > Settings > Emails (with live preview)
  • “Request a Quote” block and “Quote List Link” block (with item counter), plus shortcodes
  • Guest and logged-in customers; the quote list follows logged-in customers across devices
  • Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS), Cart & Checkout blocks and block themes
  • GDPR: personal data export and erasure through the WordPress privacy tools
  • Translation ready, template overrides from your theme, developer friendly hooks
  • Your data stays yours: quotes and settings are never removed unless you choose so

Pro add-on

The Pro add-on adds everything you need to close the deal:

  • Send priced proposals: edit prices and quantities, add products, discounts, shipping and fees
  • Customers accept or reject online; accepted quotes become a WooCommerce order with a payment link
  • PDF quotes attached to emails and downloadable by customers
  • Rules: show the quote button, hide prices or Add to cart by user role, guest/logged-in, category, tag, product or stock status
  • Form builder with custom fields (dropdowns, checkboxes, dates, numbers, file uploads)
  • “Quotes” in My Account, quote expiry and automatic reminders
  • Create quotes from the admin, cart-to-quote button, CAPTCHA (Cloudflare Turnstile / reCAPTCHA v3), webhooks and reports

Upgrading keeps all your quotes and settings — Pro builds on top of the free plugin.

Shortcodes

  • [blraq_quote] — the quote list and request form (the “Request a Quote” block does the same)
  • [blraq_quote_link label="Quote" show_count="yes"] — link to the quote page with the number of items
  • [blraq_button id="123"] — an “Add to quote” button for a product

For developers

Templates can be copied to yourtheme/brainlessitc-request-product-quote-for-woocommerce/ and changed there. The plugin exposes many actions and filters, for example blraq_is_product_quotable, blraq_hide_price, blraq_form_fields, blraq_validate_submission, blraq_quote_created and blraq_quote_status_changed.

External services

This plugin integrates the Freemius SDK (https://freemius.com) to offer optional usage insights, the Add-Ons page and the purchase of the Pro add-on.

  • Opt-in usage data: after activation you can choose to share basic, non-sensitive data (site URL, WordPress / PHP / plugin versions, admin name and email, plugin events such as activation and deactivation). Nothing is sent unless you opt in, and you can opt out at any time. This helps us improve compatibility and send important security notices.
  • Add-Ons page / checkout: when you open Quotes > Add-Ons, details and pricing of the Pro add-on are loaded from Freemius, and purchases are processed by Freemius.

Freemius Terms of Service: https://freemius.com/terms/
Freemius Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

The plugin does not use any other external service.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install the plugin from Plugins > Add New (search for “BrainlessITC Request Product Quote”) or upload the zip, then activate it.
  3. A “View Quote” page (the quote list and request form) is created automatically. Check Quotes > Settings to choose where the button is shown and whether prices / Add to cart should be hidden.
  4. Optionally add the “Quote List Link” block to your header so customers can reach their quote list.
sections.faq:
Does it work with block themes and the WooCommerce product blocks?

Yes. The button is added to the classic templates, the “Add to Cart Form” / “Add to Cart with Options” blocks and the “Product Button” block used by the Product Collection block.

Can I hide prices only for some products?

Yes. Every product has a “Request a Quote” tab in the product data box where you can override the global settings (allow quotes, hide price, hide Add to cart).

Where do I change the email texts?

In WooCommerce > Settings > Emails: “New quote request”, “Quote request received” and “Quote reply”. You can preview them there.

Will I lose my quotes if I deactivate or delete the plugin?

No. Deactivating never deletes anything. Deleting the plugin only removes data when you enable “Remove data on uninstall” in Quotes > Settings > Advanced.

Does the plugin send data to external services?

Not by default. See “External services” below: data is only shared with Freemius if you opt in, and the Add-Ons page loads information about the Pro add-on from Freemius when you open it.
